abilities.name: Pyromania
abilities.description: Gain 40 Armor and deal 40 damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 4 seconds. Each Hero hit by Flame Stream reduces Pyromania's cooldown by 4 seconds.; 90; trait

fields.notes: Does not affect unaggroed neutral Mercenaries. Cooldown reduction can trigger for both streams as well as the bonus damage from hitting an enemy with both. Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack. Blaze's Basic Attacks Splash in a 55 degree wide cone starting from the weapon he is firing with and hit all targets in front of him, up to 5.05 range. Blaze alternates the hand he uses to attack, causing a small offset to the starting point of every Basic Attack.

abilities.name: Flame Stream
abilities.description: Fire two streams that deal 76 damage to enemies hit, and an additional 120 damage to enemies hit by both streams. Flame Stream Ignites Oil Spills it comes in contact with.

fields.notes: Additional damage cannot affect Structures. If multiple Blazes are on a team, the double hit effect can be triggered by single Flame Streams from different Blazes if they hit the target within 0.25 seconds of each other.

abilities.name: Oil Spill
abilities.description: Dispense a slick of oil that lasts for 5 seconds and Slows enemies that come in contact with it by 50%. Oil Spills are Ignited for 2.5 seconds when hit by Flame Stream. Ignited Oil Spills no longer Slow enemies, but instead deal 16 damage to them every 0.3 seconds. Additionally, Blaze is healed for 49 Health every 0.3 seconds while standing in Ignited Oil Spills. Stores up to 2 charges.; 12 / 1.0

fields.notes: 1) One Oil Spill consists of three smaller circular puddles with 1.5 radius, with the centers 1.5 units apart. Each smaller Oil puddle provides vision in 2.5 radius. Igniting an Oil Spill sets its remaining duration to 2.5 seconds regardless of how long it has been on the ground. If no secondary direction is issued, Oil Spill will be cast toward the direction Blaze is facing. Self-casting creates an Oil Spill starting from Blaze's feet toward the direction he is facing. Blaze can ignite any ally Blaze's Oil Spill, but only the Blaze who Ignited the Oil can heal from it.

abilities.name: Jet Propulsion
abilities.description: After 0.375 seconds, charge forward. Colliding with an enemy Hero deals 52 damage to all nearby enemy Heroes and Stuns them for 1.25 seconds.

fields.type: Crowd control, Spell Damage / Movement: Dash
fields.notes: Enemies that are immune to skillshots cannot be hit by the initial dash, but can be affected by the impact, as long as they are not also immune to AoE. Does not search inside of Blaze's own hitbox upon a successful cast, so units who can ignore collision such as Dehaka with Dark Swarm active will not be hit if overlapping with Blaze on cast.

abilities.name: Bunker Drop
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435 Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 150 damage to enemies in a line. Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed. Bunker

fields.notes: Upon cast, Blaze automatically enters the Bunker. Otherwise, entering the Bunker requires a 0.5 second Stationary channel. Bunker Drop is interrupted, putting it on a 10 second cooldown, if Blaze dies or is put in Stasis during the initial delay. Heroes inside the Bunker are put in Stasis. In addition to usual effects of Stasis, the targets are removed from ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles), have no collision and cannot be seen on the minimap or revealed. Damage dealt by bunker is unaffected by hero damage modifers. Players can exit the Bunker to a direction of their choice, 1 second after entering. Exiting the Bunker requires you to target an area you have vision over. If the Bunker is put in Time Stop (by Void Prison), all units inside are put in Time Stop as well. If Blaze is put in Time Stop during the initial delay, the Bunker drops as usual after the Time Stop ends.

abilities.name: Combustion
abilities.description: Channel for up to 2.6 seconds. Upon ending, Slow nearby enemies by 60% and deal 55 damage to them every 0.5 seconds. Combustion's Slow and damage over time duration is extended the longer Blaze Channels, from 1 second up to 5 seconds. Blaze's Movement Speed is reduced by 40% while Channeling.; 80 / 0.5

fields.props: Area of Effect, Damage over Time, Mobile channel, Slow
fields.notes: Every 0.3125 seconds of channeling increases Slow and DoT duration by 0.5 seconds Combustion can be reactivated after 0.5 seconds to trigger its end effect early. Interrupting Combustion in any way during its channel fires it with its accumulated duration. During the channel Blaze can Mount by targeting an ally Mounted with the Toy Train equipped.

talents.name: Burn Notice
talents.description: Basic Attacks Slow enemies by 5% and deal an additional 18 damage over 2.5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.

fields.props: Attack Modifier, Damage over Time, Slow
fields.notes: Damage stacks up to 6 times, not 5, though the Slow stacks up to 5 times. Basic Attacks deal a tick of damage per new stack and refresh the duration of all stacks. They also restart the DoT tick timer for each stack, synchronizing them (so the next damage tick for all stacks will be 0.5s after the most recent Basic Attack). This also means DoT ticks that happen on the same server tick (1/16 s) as a Basic Attack generally happen twice (the DoT takes place and then the on-hit DoT tick from the Basic Attack resolves) There is observed to be about a 75% chance of this happening when a Basic Attack resolves, and a 25% chance of only 1 tick per stack, for reasons not fully understood. This is hypothesized to be because the Basic Attack, which applies and refreshes DoT durations, and the pre-scheduled DoT ticks happen on the same server tick, so which resolves first is seemingly random.

_raw_fields: Basic Attacks Slow enemies by 5% and deal an additional 18 damage over 2.5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
